message: So, the other day I was making dinner when I suddenly remembered I hadn’t tested the smoke alarm in ages. I mean, who actually does that? I grabbed a chair, climbed up, and just as I was about to give it a little poke, I knocked over a pot of spaghetti. There I was, trying to save dinner while also trying to make sure I didn’t burn the house down! Lesson learned: a quick check on those smoke alarms is way easier than dealing with smoke and sauce everywhere. Ever had a moment like that where you realized you weren't quite as ready as you thought?
